summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd, via its majority-owned subsidiary Fort Technology Inc., filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, disclosing interim financial statements and a press release announcing agreements to acquire a majority stake in Logia USA, a fuel integrity solutions provider for data centers. The filing also notes an adjustment to the exercise price of Series A, June 2026 PIPE, and June 2026 Note warrants, effective August 13, 2026, to $2.398704 per ordinary share. No financial terms, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The acquisition aligns with Nexera's expansion into data center infrastructure. Watch for completion due diligence and regulatory approvals; the warrant adjustment may affect dilution.
